items: Invite with 💌s instead of chatting: on the ground, click (or hold 1) to throw a burst of spinning 💌s at the cursor; on a gamepad, aim with the right stick and throw with a trigger; on touch, the 💌 button throws them the way you're going
Each 💌 that lands fills a little meter of hearts over the creature (babies need a few, adults many); it drains slowly if you stop; full, the creature joins your party
You call out with an emoji every time you throw, and the creature you hit answers, warming up as its meter fills
A creature's reply bubble is sized by its level: babies' smallest, legends' largest (yours stays the same)
Enraged creatures and legends block 💌s (they answer 😠); your own party animals let them through

Enraged creatures wear angry brows over their red eyes; dazed ones see stars; happy ones wear party clothes without the glowing collar (that's for your party), and dance where there's a soundsystem; legends never dress up
